product: Composting Products from Coffee in Tunisia

image.notes: runtime requirements only; the grading harness runs inside the image, it does not build it

persistent_volume.ownership: the image declares ENV STORAGE_PATH=/data and creates /data owned by uid 10001 before dropping to it

database.backend_switch: app/db.py reads DATABASE_URL; set means Postgres (psycopg v3), absent means SQLite under STORAGE_PATH
database.single_decider: app/db.py resolved_url(), read by app/migrations.py and alembic/env.py

required_settings_notes.PLATFORM_TOKEN: no default: absent means every /v1 route answers 401. Tokens come from the deploy environment only.
required_settings_notes.PLATFORM_TAX_RATE: the customer's Tunisian VAT rate as a decimal fraction (0.19 = 19%); read through app.money_settings at the point of use.
required_settings_notes.STORAGE_PATH: /data in the container; absent or unwritable is 503.

customer_settings_to_set.PLATFORM_TAX_RATE: the customer's Tunisian VAT rate; 0.19 is the standard rate shipped as an example, not a hardcoded rule
customer_settings_to_set.PLATFORM_RATE_COMPOST_YIELD: finished compost kg per kg of input; the factory's own process ratio
customer_settings_to_set.PICKUP_SHORTFALL_ALERT_PCT: shortfall above which the collection team is alerted
customer_settings_to_set.COMPOST_*: the curing and quality bands the production floor works to

connector_settings.note: this blueprint declares no placeholder connectors; every capability runs end to end

network_notes: no outbound HTTP at runtime, no block-store callback, no cloud LLM: the twelve blocks are vendored in vendor/ and dispatched in-process
backup: scripts/backup.sh (pg_dump on DATABASE_URL, otherwise a SQLite .backup of $STORAGE_PATH/platform.db)
